properties.name: v-model
properties.description: Binding data with v-model (2 strings array of from date, to date)

properties.name: inputType
properties.description: The date-format entered in the text-field area.

properties.name: modelType
properties.description: Value for return type. Date value will be converted with this option when you receive

properties.name: strictRange
properties.description: If you set range or strictRange to true, you can select a date-range.

properties.name: customPreset
properties.description: A button of preset can be customized. {label: String, action: String} An Array with elements, each element representing one segment-button. label is the text displayed in the segment-button, and action uses the same format as init props, with values ​​such as 'clear', 'today', '{unit} [+-]?'.

properties.name: preset
properties.description: Whether to handle preset deactivation

properties.name: segmentWrapperBind
properties.description: If you want to add additional options to the ur-segment-wrapper resulting from the preset props configuration, you can pass props, class and style as object types to the segment-wrapper-bind.

properties.name: oneInputMode
properties.description: Whether to display as one input.

properties.name: autoConfirm
properties.description: Whether to enter automatically when selecting a period.

properties.name: init
properties.description: You can set the initial value of v-model when the component is created.

properties.name: minDate
properties.description: You can set a selectable minimum date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

properties.name: maxDate
properties.description: You can set a selectable maximum date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

properties.name: noPlaceholder
properties.description: The no-placeholder option may not display the placeholder.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size You must enter one of two types: medium or small.

properties.name: clearLabel
properties.description: You can set the text for the clear button in the calendar area. Created for multilingual processing.The size You must enter one of two types: medium or small.

properties.name: clearable
properties.description: Apply button clear to clear date of the Calendar.

properties.name: confirmLabel
properties.description: You can set the text for the confirm button in the calendar area.

properties.name: messageStyle
properties.description: Guide, Success, Announcement appearance attributes. You can specify the 'heavy' and 'light' attributes.

properties.name: guideMessage
properties.description: The string to display as the guide message.

properties.name: successMessage
properties.description: successMessage

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Rule-set for using validator. Specified by an Array type, each element returns a boolean true on successful validation and a validate failure error message.

properties.name: lazy
properties.description: Components that use ur-validator-mixin call validateOnEvent() based on component properties. If lazy is set to true, validate() will not execute when validateOnEvent() is called.

properties.name: noShake
properties.description: Determines whether shake animation should be applied to the component when it fails.

properties.name: fixedMessage
properties.description: Show message fixed style.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Create a non-interactive state.

events.name: toggle-floating
events.description: It fires when calendar appears or disappears.

events.name: input
events.description: When the input value is changed, an event is triggered with the changed value as a parameter.
